summary: Verified the Meetings page perf refactor: initial load consolidated into a single GET /api/meetings/page-data call. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (1 create/delete test skipped due to strict business-validation on POST /meetings/ minimal payload — not part of this refactor). Frontend: admin and staff role flows both make exactly one /meetings/page-data call and zero /dashboard calls; UI renders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: meetings.py:555 and org.py:236 use `request.state.db_conn_org_id == org_id` guard cleanly to fall back to a fresh connection when the deps-cached connection is for a different org — good defensive pattern, no leak risk observed.

get_meetings_page_data runs 3 sub-fetches sequentially on the reused connection (await x3). If any single stage grows to be slow it would serialise — acceptable for now (median 1.1s per main-agent timing), but consider `asyncio.gather` only if each helper can be made safe on the same asyncpg conn (asyncpg conn is not concurrent — so sequential is actually correct; leave as-is).
test_credentials: admin@supervision.com / Admin123!X ; user@supervision.com / Staff123! ; manager@supervision.com / Manager123! (MFA via get_tokens.py)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_meetings_page_data.py covers: /meetings/page-data (admin/manager/staff shape, keys, current-month exclusion from month_summary, cross-check vs standalone endpoints, unauth 401, defaults), standalone regression (/meetings/, /meetings/month-summary, /org/structure-lite, /org/structure heavy — unaffected). The create+delete test is skipped because POST /api/meetings/ needs a richer payload than the minimal one — deletion path was NOT re-verified via API and should be exercised via UI or expanded payload if regressed. Frontend confirmed: only ONE /meetings/page-data call on initial /meetings load for both admin and staff; org-filter-bar visible for admin (5 status chips: All / Draft 21 / In Review 9 / Reviewed 1 / Signed Off 1, 'All Settings' dropdown present) and correctly hidden for staff (settings array empty).
rca of the issue: N/A — refactor verification, no bugs found.
